name: winteam-standards
description: General-purpose code standards for the WinTeam mobile app: file and method size limits, maximum parameter counts, layer boundaries, Manager contracts, Response-to-Entity mapping, use cases, vertical-slice composition, helper reuse across the MobileCore submodule, subscription teardown, TinyIoC dependency injection, MVVM source generators, naming and documentation rules (the /// block and the no-narrating-comment rules are measured on the file, not only stated), member declaration order — state above behaviour and a single-caller helper below its caller, checked in all three projects and advisory-only because a reorder is a judgment call rather than a keystroke, and the presentation-layer conventions — AppStrings localization, dark-mode and tablet theming, and static styling in markup rather than setup code — the last four enforced on the markup surface itself, not only on C#. The size, parameter, documentation and layer rules are also delivered at planning time, while the implementation plan is being written, not only when the file is authored. Every file a session creates, modifies or renames is re-checked at the end of the turn, and that check is the one hook here that can hand the turn back rather than only advise. Not branch-specific — applies to WinTeam.Mobile.Core and both platform projects on any branch.
